map.股价 / 每股账面价值: Share Price / Book Value per Share
map.📖 查看「股价 / 每股账面价值 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Share Price / Book Value per Share User Guide"
map.P/B = 股价/每股账面价值: P/B = share price / book value per share
map.P/B<1 可能被低估（需结合资产质量）。: P/B < 1 may be undervalued (need to combine with asset quality).
map.股价除以每股净资产，衡量市值相对账面价值的溢价。: Share price divided by net assets per share, measuring the premium of market value over book value.
map.银行/重资产行业常用（资产可计量）。: Commonly used in banks/asset-heavy industries (assets are measurable).
map.破净（P/B<1）选股与价值陷阱识别。: Stock picking below book (P/B < 1) and value-trap identification.
map.P/B = 30/5 = 6。即市值 6 倍于每股净资产。: P/B = 30/5 = 6. That is, market value is 6x the net assets per share.
map.股价 4、BVPS 5：P/B=4/5=0.8 <1，市值低于账面（破净），需核: Share price 4, BVPS 5: P/B = 4/5 = 0.8 < 1, market value below book (below book), need to check whether asset quality hides landmines.
map.P/B 适用于哪些行业？: Which industries is P/B suitable for?
map.重资产、资产可可靠计量者（银行、地产、钢铁）适用；轻资产/科技股无形资产多，P/: Asset-heavy, reliably measurable assets (banks, real estate, steel) fit; light-asset/tech stocks have many intangibles and P/B is distorted.
map.未必。可能资产减值风险高、ROE 低。需结合 ROE：P/B 低但 ROE 也低: Not necessarily. It may have high impairment risk and low ROE. Combine with ROE: low P/B but also low ROE is not necessarily undervalued.
